annotation: The participant rubbed their right index finger over their right cheekbone, slightly squinted, tilted their head to the right, and gave a forced smile.
The participant extended both hands forward, gently tapping the back of their left hand against their right palm a few times, leaned forward slightly, and their eyes narrowed.
The participant leaned forward, extended their arms forward, mimicking holding a steering wheel, raised their eyebrows, and pursed their lips.
The participant rocked their body with a flowing, wave-like movement and glided their hands along their body
The participant held their left hand to the side of their mouth as if whispering a secret and smiled with raised cheeks.
The participant leaned forward, slightly bending at the waist, maintained eye contact, and their right index finger extended and pointed towards their lower left.
